svg.title: Boxed No-History: MoMaRT policy architecture
svg.desc: Two recent multimodal observations are encoded into two 256-dimensional tokens, with a task embedding. A PTP Transformer predicts action noise over a nine-step, ten-dimensional action chunk. Long-term episodic memory is removed. Only main RGB receives a red box cue; other modalities are unchanged.

g.text: Target cues in pixels, recent observations for control
Red outline only on main RGB
Missing box → original RGB. No ROI tokens; other modalities unchanged.
clean actions + Gaussian noise → predict ε → denoising loss
Blue: recent observations / control Green: learned policy modules Pink: diffusion / cue operations
